sources.title: MobileViT - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MobileViT is a lightweight vision transformer for mobile devices that merges CNNs's efficiency and inductive biases with transformers global context modeling. It treats transformers as convolutions, enabling global information processing without the heavy computational cost of standard ViTs.
